The '''Fluwhaka system''' was a star system located within the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the planet [[Fluwhaka]].
